## Summary
- What changed and why.

## Scope
- Domain: `core` / `combat` / `capture` / `ai` / `ui` / `audio` / `tools`
- Type: `feat` / `fix` / `perf` / `refactor` / `chore`

## Validation
- [ ] `dotnet build .\Assembly-CSharp.csproj -v minimal`
- [ ] Relevant Unity EditMode/PlayMode tests run
- [ ] Manual verification completed in changed scenes

## Unity Safety Checklist
- [ ] `.meta` files included for moved/added assets
- [ ] No accidental changes in `Library/`, `Temp/`, `obj/`, `Logs/`
- [ ] Scene/prefab changes are intentional and reviewed
- [ ] No new console errors in Play Mode

## Visual Evidence (UI/VFX if applicable)
- Attach screenshots or short clips.

- Risk level: Low / Medium / High
